messages.author: 0631c9d875251b52
messages.subject: break-out of infinite loop
parts:
Hi Everybody,

How to stop and break-out of an infinite loop when I get 

Error evaluating model log probability: Non-finite gradient.
Error evaluating model log probability: Non-finite gradient.
Error evaluating model log probability: Non-finite gradient.
Error evaluating model log probability: Non-finite gradient.

This happens when I am calling optimizing from pystan .

Since this script is going to be run in batch periodically, I would like to detect or limit the maximum number of times it retries when it encounters this error. Currently it just keeps retrying and blocks rest of the script.


Thanks,
Sunil.
